about: Each world body's air and indoor air, as the scene-record stage writes them into a place's record (score/stages/scene_record): what a room's air holds, how the camera is exposed, the haze, dust and day dome of a body's air, its harbour and kit glow (its lamps are the scene inventory's glowing rows, numbered by the library's lamp, data/library/lamps.json). Its sky is not here: the suns, the worlds overhead and the stars are the environment concept's physics, worked out at each scene's site at its scene time and written by the light layer (score/stages/light/sky.py; the owner, 2026-10-21: no fixed sky). Unverified seed numbers: these are the values every Moon room's old record held, kept here once instead of in each record until the light stage's sweep against each place's concept sets them.

indoor.from: seed: the indoor environment, haze and room fill every Moon room's old scene record held alike (airlock, garage, greenhouse, habitat, lab, workshop, hangar, hub), not yet measured against a concept

outdoor.about: A body's outdoor air over every place on it, in the body's own frame (the ball's middle, as the terrain stage's grounds are laid), turned into each place's frame through its seat.

environment.from: seed: the old outdoor records' numbers, not yet measured against a concept

haze.from: seed: Mars's air the old Mars records held, a body of fog round the ball 70 m deep

dust.from: seed: one still moment of the calm day's drift over the 70 m square round the place's middle, as the old Mars records held it

sky_dome.from: the framework's (2026-10-11): tools/usd/mars_sky.py's single scattering of a dust layer seen from its floor, lit by the record's sun; albedo in red after Wolff et al. 2009 at 650 nm, forward throw 0.67 after Chen-Chen et al. 2019 (MSL Navcam), depth 0.6 and diffuse the framework's; the gain measured by the light stage's sweep of the rendered sky against concept K05

earth.about: The Earth's launch night round the prologue's places, in the street's frame (EarthSite's own: x across the block, -x toward the harbour, z along the street, y up from the street), which the made ground's seats stand in each place's frame. Unverified seed numbers: what the old records of the flat, stairwell, street, square and launch view held alike, not yet measured against a concept.

glow.from: the game's night glow while the eye is at the Earth site, over every place there (night.gd:35-37,128-138: NIGHT_GLOW_THRESHOLD 0.85; lighting.json bounce_tuned glow_intensity 0.8; Godot's Environment defaults for the rest), as the square's old record held it; once data/light/launch.json, a hand-kept file of one place

night.from: seed: the night sky, ambient, exposure and haze ring the street's and the flat's old records held

kit_glow.from: seed: how the night lights a kit's glowing kinds, as the outdoor places' old records held it

harbour.from: seed: the harbour's reach from the quay (x -110) out to the old far disc's 320 m, and how its water mirrors the lit rocket, as the old records held it
